summary: Iteration 42: frontend-only retest of the 2 LOW polish items from iteration_41 on the 'Add a business' sheet (new-biz-modal), opened from Profile > profile-add-business. Logged in with the test account. Nothing was created. BOTH FIXED. (1) Tile alignment: the right tile (Sole Trader/Charity) right edge now matches the new-biz-name input right edge exactly (delta 0px), and the left edges also match (0px). Values: 1440 -> 1013 vs 1013; 1024 -> 805 vs 805; 800 -> 693 vs 693; 700 -> 574 vs 574; 390 -> 374 vs 374. (2) Grabber: no 40x4 grabber at 1440, 1024 or 800 (centred card, w=620). The grabber is present at 700 and 390 (bottom sheet). NOTE: the review request expected 700px to be the tablet centred card. 700 is below 768, so the app uses the phone web shell there: a 480px bottom sheet at x=110 with the grabber visible. This matches the tier spec and iteration_41, so tablet was checked at 800px instead. Functional checks: choosing a type swaps the optional field correctly (ltd -> new-biz-ch, sole_trader -> new-biz-vat, charity -> new-biz-charity). Submitting with an empty name shows new-biz-error 'Please enter a name for the business'. Cancel closes the sheet and clears the form on reopen. Tapping the backdrop closes the sheet. No deprecated Expo packages were found in the files reviewed.
action_items: Optional, LOW: add testID (e.g. 'new-biz-cancel') to the Cancel Pressable in add-business-modal.tsx line 196 for testability.
critical_code_review_comments: typeCardWeb uses calc(50% - 4px), which is gap/2 for gap=spacing.sm(8). It is web-only, so the native 48% layout stays frozen. Correct.
Grabber is gated on !dsheet.isDesktop, which is true for web tablet and desktop (≥768). Native and phone web keep the grabber. Correct.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Open the sheet with '[data-testid=profile-add-business]:visible' on /profile. Scope measurements to '[data-testid=new-biz-modal]:visible'. 700px is the phone web shell (bottom sheet + grabber). Tablet tier starts at 768.
